d2i=[[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,0,0,2,7,2,2,2,2],[7]*9,[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2]]
d2o=[[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,0,0,2,7,2,0,0,2],[7]*9,[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,7,2,2,2,2],[2,0,0,2,7,2,0,0,2]]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    flat=[v for r in grid for v in r]
    bg=Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seprows=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==grid[i][0] for v in grid[i]) and len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=bg]
    sepcols=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==grid[0][j] if False else grid[i][j]==grid[i][j] for i in range(h))]
    sepcols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h) if i not in seprows})==1 and next(iter({grid[i][j] for i in range(h) if i not in seprows}))!=bg]
    rseps=sorted(set([-1]+seprows+[h])); cseps=sorted(set([-1]+sepcols+[w]))
    panels=[(rseps[k]+1,rseps[k+1],cseps[l]+1,cseps[l+1]) for k in range(len(rseps)-1) for l in range(len(cseps)-1)]
    def get(p):
        a,b,c,d=p
        return [row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    pat=None
    for p in panels:
        sub=get(p)
        if any(v!=bg for row in sub for v in row) and any(v!=bg for row in get(panels[0]) for v in row) is not None:
            pass
    # pattern = panel with the most non-bg colors distinct / most non-bg cells
    def score(p):
        sub=get(p); return sum(v!=bg for row in sub for v in row)
    pat=get(max(panels,key=score))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,dd in panels:
        for i,rr in enumerate(range(a,b)):
            out[rr][c:dd]=pat[i%len(pat)]
    return out
print(transform(d1i)==d1o, transform(d2i)==d2o)
